parole.significato: to spurt (out of); to emanate (from) [with da]
parole.testo: Borrowed from Middle High German spretzen, sprützen (modern German spritzen (“to squirt”)), from Old High German spruzzen, spruzzjan (> Italian spruzzare), from Proto-West Germanic *spruttjan. Compare also Old High German sprizza (“sprinkler”).

Borrowed from Middle High German sprützen (“to squirt”), from Old High German spruzzen, spruzzjan, from Proto-West Germanic *spruttjan, from Proto-Germanic *spreutaną (“to come out, to spring forth”). Cognate to German spritzen.
